```cypher
MATCH (p:Plugin {name: "oohoo - TabTopics format"})-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(c:Category)
MATCH (alternative:Plugin)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(c)
WHERE alternative.component <> p.component
OPTIONAL MATCH (alternative)-[:MAINTAINS]->(m:Maintainer)
RETURN alternative.component, alternative.name, COLLECT(DISTINCT m.display_name) AS maintainers
LIMIT 100
```
